name: Chinese PigLoad
summary:
In this game you must drop pigs into a box to hold it on the balance.
The pigs affect the balance according to their distance from the Chinese motorcycle.

Match 3 pigs of the same color vertically or horizontally to remove them from the playfield.

Every pig has its own weight, so let them fall wisely. The weight is shown in the nose of each pig.

If one side of the box hits the ground, the game is over.

Use special pigs like column cleaner pig, row cleaner pig and the joker pig for a faster playfield cleaning and better score.
